name: SafeDollar reward pool deflationary-token accounting
summary: SdoRewardPool credited the nominal PLX deposit and returned that nominal amount even though PLX burned 0.15% on transfer. Repeated deposit/withdraw cycles depleted the pool's actual PLX balance to two wei; updatePool() divided newly accrued SDO by that balance, inflating accSdoPerShare and allowing a pre-positioned stake to mint unbacked SDO.
notes: The add(500, PLX, 0, 1623470400) calldata installed deflationary PLX 0x7a5dc8a09c831251026302c93a778748dd48b4df as pool 9, changing poolLength() from 9 to 10 and creating the vulnerable code-and-token combination. The operator's only later call before exploitation changed pool 8, not pool 9.

The campaign's final transaction transfers exactly 202,230.248261 USDC and 46,006.739506 USDT from the two SDO liquidity pools to the attacker helper after the helper sells the unbacked reward SDO. Stablecoins are valued at par.
